_comment: DSH multi-window launcher configuration. ONE server, MANY windows is the default because each server process eagerly starts its own five stdio MCP bridges (~1.4 GB per server measured 2026-09-11). Set mode to 'multi' only when you deliberately want a second isolated engine.

_modes.single: One DSH server on primaryPort; every window attaches to it. Sessions are independent; the engine is shared.
_modes.multi: Each slot runs its own DSH server on its own port. Independent engines, ~1.4 GB each, five MCP bridges each.

_fields.window.label: Human label, shown in the window title and in status output.
_fields.window.workspace: Default working directory (the agent's workspace root) opened in that window's sessions.
_fields.window.profile: Browser profile directory suffix. Must be unique per window: it is what gives each window its own cookie jar and its own 'last session'.
_fields.window.enabled: false keeps the slot defined but never opens it.
_fields.window.port: Only used in 'multi' mode: the port that window's own server listens on.

_multiPorts._comment: Only read in mode 'multi'. Ports are assigned from basePort upward, in window order.
